reviews.name: McKenzie Bauer
reviews.comment: Would not recommend to anyone. The first time I ordered from them was great. Very commutative and walked me through all the order specifics. Since the last year; either the owner/employees or manufacturing has changed. They are very uncommunicative. They do not rely any specifics about the jerseys and expect you to just know how they make and manufacture them. I requested there be absolutely no “slugger” branding on my jerseys and just like I did for my first order. When I received my second order, the slugger branding was on them. I’ve tried to get it fixed and after numerous conversations they have failed to fix my order or refund me. Would not recommend and will be finding another company to make our jerseys from now on.
